title: Efficiency boost in perovskite solar cells via TiO2 nanodiscs embedded in the MoSe2 electron transport layer revealed by optoelectronic simulations
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1797-1811
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01414F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Javad Maleki, Maryam Shahrostami, Siming Huang, Mojtaba Abdi-Jalebi
This work introduces a breakthrough metasurface-based design for inverted perovskite solar cells, where TiO2 nanodiscs embedded in a MoSe2 electron transport layer enhances light management and charge transport, boosting efficiency from 15% to 19%.
